records.jp: うっ、うう……
records.en_original: *sniffle*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sniffle*
records.en: *sniffle*...

records.jp: ユズ……。　ライム……
records.en_original: Yuzu... Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu... Lime...
records.en: Yuzu... Lime...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina-chan...

records.jp: ユズ、ライム。<CR>二人とも、どうして……？
records.en_original: W-Wait... How are you two still...?
records.en_auxiliary: W-wait... How are you two still...?
records.en: Yuzu... Lime...<CR>How are you two still...?

records.jp: わからない……
records.en_original: I don't know...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know...
records.en: I don't know...

records.jp: ひょっとして、消えなくてもよくなったんじゃ？
records.en_original: Could it mean that maybe you won't disappear after all?
records.en_auxiliary: Could this mean that maybe you won't disappear after all?
records.en: Could it mean that maybe you won't disappear after all?

records.jp: そんなこと、絶対にない
records.en_original: I wish it did, but that can't be true...
records.en_auxiliary: I wish it did, but that can't be true...
records.en: No. That can't possibly be true.

records.jp: ライムたちが消えないってことは、<CR>“この戦いが終わってない”ってこと
records.en_original: If we're still here, then this battle isn't over.
records.en_auxiliary: If we're still here, then this battle isn't over.
records.en: If Lime and the others aren't disappearing,<CR>then this battle isn't over.

records.jp: そして、世界が元通りにならないってこと
records.en_original: And the world hasn't been restored to its previous state, either.
records.en_auxiliary: And the world hasn't been restored to its previous state, either.
records.en: And the world hasn't been restored to its previous state, either.

records.jp: どうして？　どうしてユズたちが消えないの！？
records.en_original: Why? Why didn't we disappear!?
records.en_auxiliary: Why? Why didn't we disappear?!
records.en: Why? Why aren't Yuzu and the others disappearing!?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん！
records.en_original: Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako!
records.en: Hinako-chan!

records.jp: 早苗……。　更紗……。　どうしたの？
records.en_original: Sanae? Sarasa? What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Sanae? Sarasa? What's wrong?
records.en: Sanae? Sarasa? What's wrong?

records.jp: た、大変なの！　学校のみんなが、消えていってるの！
records.en_original: We have a BIG problem! Everyone in school is disappearing!
records.en_auxiliary: We have a BIG problem! Everyone in school is disappearing!
records.en: Th-This is terrible! Everyone at school is disappearing!

records.jp: ええっ！？
records.en_original: What!?
records.en_auxiliary: What?!
records.en: What!?

records.jp: そんな……どうして……
records.en_original: No way... But why...?
records.en_auxiliary: No way... But why...?
records.en: No way... But why...?

records.jp: 見て、あれ！
records.en_original: Look! Over there!
records.en_auxiliary: Look! Over there!
records.en: Look! Over there!

records.jp: あれは……、原種……？<CR>でも、どうしてまだ残ってるの？
records.en_original: Is that a Sephira? But why is it still alive?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that...a Sephira? But why is there still one left?
records.en: Is that...a Sephira...?<CR>But why is it still here?

records.jp: あれは、コモンの化身『ダアト』……
records.en_original: That is Daath, the embodiment of the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: That is Daath, the embodiment of the Common.
records.en: That is Daath, the embodiment of the Common.

records.jp: （よくぞ勝利した。小さな欠片たちよ。感謝の意を示そう）
records.en_original: (Victory is yours, dearest fragments of mine. In light of your triumph, I offer you my respect.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Victory is yours, dearest fragments of mine. In light of your triumph, I offer you my respect.)
records.en: (You have done well to win, little fragments. Allow me to express my gratitude.)

records.jp: どう、いたしまして……
records.en_original: You're...welcome.
records.en_auxiliary: You're...welcome.
records.en: You're...welcome.

records.jp: ダアト。どうして、勝ったのに終わってないの？
records.en_original: Daath. We've won. Why isn't it over?
records.en_auxiliary: Daath. We've won. Why isn't it over?
records.en: Daath. We've won. Why isn't it over?

records.jp: （その問いに、答えよう）
records.en_original: (I shall grant you an answer.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I shall grant you an answer.)
records.en: (I shall grant you an answer.)

records.jp: （我は、前の戦いより、人の想いの力を糧に戦うことにした）
records.en_original: (Millennia ago, when I battled with my kin, I chose to arm myself with mankind's emotion.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Millennia ago, when I battled with my kin, I chose to arm myself with mankind's emotions.)
records.en: (Beginning with the previous battle, I chose to fight by feeding on the power of human emotions.)

records.jp: （それこそが、最も力を、<CR>エーテルエネルギーを生み出すと考えたからだ）
records.en_original: (Their emotional core generates ether energy -- the most powerful force in existence.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Their emotional core generates ether energy—the most powerful force in existence.)
records.en: (I believed that would generate the greatest power—<CR>ether energy.)

records.jp: （事実、前の戦いではたやすく勝利をおさめることができた）
records.en_original: (I made use of this in the previous battle to vanquish my opponents with ease.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I made use of this in the previous battle to vanquish my opponents with ease.)
records.en: (And indeed, in the previous battle, I was able to win with ease.)

records.jp: （そしてこの世界を、人の住みやすい環境に変えた。人の数が<CR>増えれば、より強いエネルギーを得られると確信していたからだ）
records.en_original: (My victory secured, I made this world more hospitable to man, hoping their larger numbers would grant me strength.)
records.en_auxiliary: (My victory secured, I made this world more hospitable to man, hoping their larger numbers would grant me strength.)
records.en: (Then I transformed this world into an environment hospitable to humans.<CR>I was convinced that increasing their numbers would yield even greater energy.)

records.jp: （しかし、それが誤りだと、この戦いで認識した）
records.en_original: (But I came to realize that this plan had a flaw.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But I came to realize that this plan had a flaw.)
records.en: (But this battle showed me that I was mistaken.)

records.jp: えっ……？　どういうこと？
records.en_original: Huh? What are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What are you talking about?
records.en: Huh? What are you talking about?

records.jp: （１００万年前、人の数は少なかったが、想いの力、絆は強かった。<CR>過酷な環境で生き延びるためお互いのことを強く強く想っていた）
records.en_original: Millions of years ago, humans were few, but their bonds were strong. They had to care for each other to survive.
records.en_auxiliary: (A million years ago, humans were few, but their bonds were strong. They had to care for each other to survive.)
records.en: (One million years ago, humans were few, but the power of their feelings—their bonds—was strong.<CR>To survive that harsh environment, they cared deeply for one another.)

records.jp: （その力を使い戦いに勝利した我は、世界を人の住みやすい環境に<CR>変えた。数を増やし、より強いエネルギーを得るためだ）
records.en_original: (Those bonds secured my victory. I had hoped that a gentler environment would strengthen those bonds, but I was wrong.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Those bonds secured my victory. I had hoped that a gentler environment would strengthen those bonds, but I was wrong.)
records.en: (Using that power, I won the battle and made this world more hospitable to humans.<CR>I did so to increase their numbers and obtain even greater energy.)

records.jp: （そして、人はこのわずかな間に、途方もなく増えた。<CR>しかし、それによって人は変わってしまった）
records.en_original: (As the human population grew exponentially, so too did their hearts begin to change.)
records.en_auxiliary: (As the human population grew exponentially, so too did their hearts begin to change.)
records.en: (In the brief time since, humanity's numbers have grown beyond measure.<CR>But in doing so, humans changed.)

records.jp: （複雑な生き方をするようになり、あれほど強かった絆は、<CR>恐ろしく希薄なものになってしまった）
records.en_original: (Ensconced within their complex societies, the strong bonds they once possessed began to crumble into oblivion.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ensconced within their complex societies, the strong bonds they once possessed began to crumble into oblivion.)
records.en: (Their way of life grew complex, and the bonds that had once been so strong<CR>became frighteningly weak.)

records.jp: なっ！　――私たちの想いが、絆が、薄いって言うの？
records.en_original: What!? Are you saying that our bonds are weak?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! Are you saying that our bonds are weak?
records.en: Wh-What!? Are you saying our feelings—our bonds—are weak?

records.jp: （そうだ。今回は何度も、他の原種を追い返すことしか<CR>できない時があった。非常に危うい勝利だった）
records.en_original: (You've seen it yourself. Many a time did we let a Sephira escape destruction. This was a narrow victory.)
records.en_auxiliary: (You've seen it yourself. Many a time the other Sephira could only be driven off. This was a narrow victory.)
records.en: (Yes. This time, there were many occasions when you could do no more than drive the other Sephira away.<CR>Your victory was extremely precarious.)

records.jp: （我は考えた。次の戦いで負けないために、どうすればいいか）
records.en_original: (I contemplated what could be done to avoid a loss in the next battle.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I contemplated what could be done to avoid a loss in the next battle.)
records.en: (I contemplated what could be done to avoid a loss in the next battle.)

records.jp: （そして答えを得た。人は、一つにまとまるべきだ。<CR>人の意識をすべて集め、長い時間をかけ、一つに融合させる）
records.en_original: Then I found my answer. Mankind should become one. I shall unify mankind by collecting and merging their consciousness.
records.en_auxiliary: (Then I found my answer. Humans should become one. I shall unify humankind by collecting and merging their consciousness.)
records.en: (Then I found my answer. Humanity should become one.<CR>I shall gather the consciousness of every human and merge it all into one over a long span of time.)

records.jp: そんな！　人間をやめろっていうの？
records.en_original: Are you joking!? Do you mean to put an end to mankind?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you joking?! Do you mean to put an end to humankind?
records.en: What!? Are you saying we should stop being human?

records.jp: （否。人はこれからも続く。これは、続けさせるための決断だ。<CR>今までとは違うステージへ、新たな一歩を踏み出すだけのこと）
records.en_original: (No. Mankind will persist. This is but a means to continue their lineage. An evolution. A new chapter.)
records.en_auxiliary: (No. Humankind will persist. This is but a means to continue their lineage. An evolution. A new chapter.)
records.en: (No. Humanity will continue. This is a decision made so that it may continue.<CR>It is merely a first step onto a new stage unlike anything before.)

records.jp: （一つになれば、お前の苦悩は消える。<CR>誰とも別れることなく、お前たちはずっと一緒にいられる）
records.en_original: (Become one, and your suffering will cease. Never again will you part ways with a loved one. Together, for all time.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Become one, and your suffering will cease. Never again will you part ways with a loved one. You will be together, for all time.)
records.en: (Become one, and your anguish will disappear.<CR>You will never have to part from anyone; you can all remain together forever.)

records.jp: 一緒に……
records.en_original: Together...
records.en_auxiliary: Together...
records.en: Together...

records.jp: （これは、弱いお前たちを守る手段でもある）
records.en_original: (This is a means to protect your fragile kind.)
records.en_auxiliary: (This is a means to protect your fragile kind.)
records.en: (This is a means to protect your fragile kind.)

records.jp: （リフレクターになる前、お前は弱かった。死んでいるように<CR>生きていた。あの時のお前だったら拒絶しなかっただろう）
records.en_original: (Before you were a Reflector, you were weak too. You lived as if you were dead. Your former self would welcome this.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Before you were a Reflector, you were weak too. You lived as if you were dead. Your former self would welcome this.)
records.en: (Before you became a Reflector, you were weak. You lived<CR>as though you were dead. Your former self would not have rejected this.)

records.jp: （また、同じように打ちひしがれる時が来ないとは、限らない。<CR>我は、お前のような弱い者を守りたい）
records.en_original: (And there may be a day where you once again experience such pain. I only wish to protect weak creatures like you.)
records.en_auxiliary: (And there may be a day where you once again experience such pain. I only wish to protect weak creatures like you.)
records.en: (You may one day be crushed by the same despair again.<CR>I wish to protect weak beings like you.)

records.jp: （これから先も、ずっと）
records.en_original: (Now and forever.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Now and forever.)
records.en: (Now and forever.)

records.jp: 私の……ような……
records.en_original: Like me...
records.en_auxiliary: Like me...
records.en: Like me...

records.jp: （今からでも、願うといい。新たなる一歩を。<CR>それで、この戦いの勝者が得るものが、本当に決まる）
records.en_original: (Go ahead and make your wish. The next step is yours. You shall decide what will come to be.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Go ahead and make your wish. The next step is yours. You shall decide what will come to be.)
records.en: (Even now, you may make your wish—for a new step.<CR>Only then will what the victor of this battle receives truly be decided.)

records.jp: 私の、願い……
records.en_original: My...wish...
records.en_auxiliary: My...wish...
records.en: My...wish...

records.jp: （確かに二人と別れなくて済むかもしれない。<CR>争いもなく、みんな一緒にいられるかもしれない）
records.en_original: (I could decide not to say goodbye to Yuzu and Lime. I could stop the conflict so that everyone could stay together...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I could decide not to say goodbye to Yuzu and Lime. I could stop the conflict so that everyone could stay together...)
records.en: (Maybe I really wouldn't have to part with Yuzu and Lime.<CR>Maybe there would be no more conflict, and everyone could stay together.)

records.jp: （叶わない願いに苦しむことも、ないのかもしれない。<CR>でも――）
records.en_original: (I could free myself from dreams that will never come true. But...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I could free myself from dreams that will never come true. But...)
records.en: (Maybe I would no longer suffer over wishes that can never come true.<CR>But—)

records.jp: ……違う
records.en_original: ...This is wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: ...This is wrong.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん？
records.en_original: Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina?
records.en: Hina-chan?

records.jp: ヒナちゃん？
records.en_original: Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina?
records.en: Hina-chan?

records.jp: ……違う！　そんなの、間違ってる！
records.en_original: ...I said, this is wrong!
records.en_auxiliary: ...I said, this is wrong!
records.en: ...No! That's wrong!

records.jp: 確かに人の心は弱い！　みんな裏表がある。<CR>お互いを傷つけることがある。そして、失うことも……
records.en_original: You're right, people's hearts are weak. They're insincere. People hurt and sometimes even lose each other...
records.en_auxiliary: You're right, people's hearts are weak. They're insincere. People hurt and sometimes even lose each other...
records.en: It is true that human hearts are weak! Everyone has two sides.<CR>We hurt one another. And sometimes, we lose people...

records.jp: でも、だからこそ絆を大事にするの！
records.en_original: But that's why we have to cherish each other!
records.en_auxiliary: But that's why we have to cherish each other!
records.en: But that is exactly why we cherish our bonds!

records.jp: 繋げたいと、しっかり守りたいと思うの！
records.en_original: That's why we wish to connect with and protect each other!
records.en_auxiliary: That's why we wish to connect with and protect each other!
records.en: That is why we want to forge bonds and protect them with all our strength!

records.jp: その過程がない関係なんて、与えられた絆なんて、意味がない。<CR>そんなのは、幻だよ！
records.en_original: A world without those realities, and the bonds that form from them is meaningless. It's just a delusion!
records.en_auxiliary: A world without those realities, and the bonds that form from them, is meaningless. It's just an illusion!
records.en: A relationship without that process—a bond simply handed to us—has no meaning.<CR>That is nothing but an illusion!

records.jp: ダアト。あなたの願う、その一歩を――
records.en_original: Daath, you wanted me to take humanity's next step. That's your wish.
records.en_auxiliary: Daath, you wanted me to take humanity's next step. That's your wish.
records.en: Daath. That next step you wish for—

records.jp: 私は、願わないっ！
records.en_original: But it's not mine!
records.en_auxiliary: But it's not mine!
records.en: I won't wish for it!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina-chan...

records.jp: （ならば、我を倒すか？　お前には、まだその力がある）
records.en_original: (Then, do you intend to defeat me? The power to do so still rests within you.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Then, do you intend to defeat me? The power to do so still rests within you.)
records.en: (Then, do you intend to defeat me? The power to do so still rests within you.)

records.jp: （しかし、この戦いの勝者はいなくなり、<CR>他の原種が出てくるだろう。それこそ、人の世界は滅ぶ）
records.en_original: (But know that toppling the victor may lead to the rise of another Sephira, and the end of humanity.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But know that toppling the victor may lead to the rise of another Sephira, and the end of humanity.)
records.en: (But if the victor of this battle disappears,<CR>another Sephira will emerge. Then the human world will truly perish.)

records.jp: いいえ。倒さない
records.en_original: No. I won't defeat you.
records.en_auxiliary: No. I won't defeat you.
records.en: No. I won't defeat you.

records.jp: （すると？）
records.en_original: (What, then?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What, then?)
records.en: (What, then?)

records.jp: 私はリフレクター。あなたを撥ね返す！
records.en_original: I am a Reflector. I will repel you!
records.en_auxiliary: I am a Reflector. I will repel you!
records.en: I am a Reflector. I will repel you!

records.jp: （面白い。ならば、示してみよ。<CR>お前たちの絆の力。いや、お前たちの力）
records.en_original: (Interesting. Then do so. Show me the strength of your bonds -- the power that humanity possesses!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Interesting. Then do so. Show me the strength of your bonds—the power that humanity possesses!)
records.en: (Interesting. Then show me.<CR>The power of your bonds—no, your power.)

records.jp: まさかこんなことになるなんてね
records.en_original: Well, I can't say I saw this coming.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I can't say I saw this coming.
records.en: I never imagined it would come to this.

records.jp: 二人とも、ごめん
records.en_original: I'm sorry, you two.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, you two.
records.en: I'm sorry, you two.

records.jp: 謝らないで。むしろ、嬉しかった
records.en_original: Don't be. This actually makes me happy.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't be. This actually makes me happy.
records.en: Don't be. This actually makes me happy.

records.jp: うん。見せてあげよう、人間の力を！
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's show Daath the power of people!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Let's show Daath the power of people!
records.en: Yeah. Let's show Daath the power of humanity!

records.jp: うん。二人とも――行くよ！
records.en_original: Right. Okay, you two! Let's go!
records.en_auxiliary: Right. Okay, you two! Let's go!
records.en: Right. Okay, you two! Let's go!
